shared_elements: T-shaped monolithic pillar with carved shaft
low-relief carving on the broad face of the pillar
vertical rectangular band or bar motif on the shaft
registers of motifs stacked vertically down the shaft
justification: Both show the same distinctive support form — a T-shaped pillar with a projecting head and a broad shaft carrying low-relief motifs organised in stacked registers, including repeated chevron/zigzag linework and vertical bar elements. The clearest difference is that B carries an explicit menagerie (quadrupeds in profile, a snake with rendered head, a long-necked bird, a row of arched creatures along the top) while A's surviving carving is largely abstract chevrons and bands with only faint animal-like forms.
